heading: Geothermal assessment, exploration information, and priority activities

tree.heading: In general
tree.text: Not later than January 1, 2012, the Secretary of the Interior, acting through the Director of the United States Geological Survey, shall—

children.text: complete a comprehensive nationwide geothermal resource assessment that examines the full range of geothermal resources in the United States; and
submit to the the 1 Committee on Natural Resources of the House of Representatives and the Committee on Energy and Natural Resources of the Senate a report describing the results of the assessment.

tree.heading: Periodic updates
tree.text: At least once every 10 years, the Secretary shall update the national assessment required under this section to support public and private sector decisionmaking.

tree.heading: Authorization of appropriations
tree.text: There are authorized to be appropriated to the Secretary of the Interior to carry out this section—

children.text: $15,000,000 for each of fiscal years 2008 through 2012; and
such sums as are necessary for each of fiscal years 2013 through 2022.

notes.text: Effective DateSection effective on the date that is 1 day after Dec. 19, 2007, see section 1601 of Pub. L. 110–140, set out as a note under section 1824 of Title 2, The Congress.
